examples.name: Basic LLM Interaction
examples.learningGoal: Understand the most direct way MALDA talks to an LLM outside a larger agent workflow.

examples.name: Conversation Management
examples.learningGoal: Move from single completions to structured multi-turn interactions.
examples.expectedOutput: Maintains a conversation over multiple turns.

examples.name: Local LLM Example
examples.description: Using LlamaCppClient for local LLM inference with GGUF models
examples.learningGoal: Highlight MALDA's strongest cross-over value: student-friendly setup and commercial local-AI control.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs local inference without external API keys.

examples.name: microgpt (Karpathy Port)
examples.description: Pure MALDA port of Karpathy's dependency-free microgpt training and inference loop
examples.learningGoal: Provide an advanced AI showcase after the learner already understands MALDA's core and applied AI workflows.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs an advanced MALDA implementation of a GPT-style training and inference loop.

examples.name: XOR Neural Net
examples.description: Train a 2-4-1 multilayer perceptron on XOR with backpropagation, from scratch
examples.learningGoal: See a complete forward/backward pass in plain MALDA before the GPT-sized microgpt showcase.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints training loss and classifies all four XOR inputs correctly.

examples.name: Linear SVM
examples.description: Train a soft-margin support vector machine with hinge loss and L2, from scratch
examples.learningGoal: See a max-margin linear separator, then why the same model cannot solve XOR.
examples.expectedOutput: Separates two 2D clusters and reports that linear SVM fails on XOR.
